title: Affective AI Safety: The Missing Piece in LLM Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and conceptual analysis highlighting systematic tendencies in emotion recognition and LLMs to assign passive emotional states (e.g., sadness, joy) to women and aggressive or dominant states to men.
Literature review and conceptual analysis noting that models reproduce stereotypes, such as disproportionately attributing anger to Black individuals.
Literature review and conceptual analysis discussing patterns of emotional misattribution and stereotyping in AI systems along religious lines.
